lines.text: God tells His people to comfort Jerusalem, because her forced labor is completed and her iniquity is pardoned.
A voice calls to prepare the way for the LORD in the Red Sea, where His glory will be revealed.
All flesh is like grass that withers, but the word of our God stands forever.
Zion is told to go up on a high mountain and say to the cities of Samaria, "Here is your God!"
The Lord GOD comes with might, and like a shepherd He gathers the lambs in His arms.
